|{{NA|None}}

===Rewards===
*[[Kandarin headgear 1]]:
**Acts as a [[light source]] when worn or held in the inventory
**While worn, gain double [[logs]] from [[regular tree]]s (no additional experience granted)
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*[[Coal trucks]] can hold up to 140 [[coal]], up from 120
*The [[flax keeper]] will offer you 30 [[Bank note|noted]] [[bow string]]s every day for 30 noted [[flax]], for a profit of {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Bow string}}-{{GEP|Flax}})*30}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*5% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course]]
